params.description: {{sbc|Innate - Living Forge:}} '''Ornn''' can purchase [[item]]s from the [[shop]] even while outside of its range and from anywhere on the battlefield, by ''forging'' them. He is able to forge any non-[[consumable item|consumable]] item, and is also presented a ''Forge Menu'' to quickly forge his recommended items. Once '''Ornn''' attempts to purchase an item, he starts forging it, causing him to {{tip|channel}} for 4 seconds. Upon completion of the channel, he builds the item and pays its {{g|gold}} cost. The channel is {{tip|interrupt|interrupted}} if '''Ornn''' takes damage from enemy {{tip|champions}} or {{tip|turrets}}. ''Living Forge'' is disabled for 4 seconds after starting the channel.
params.description2:
{{sbc|Innate - Master Craftsman:}} '''Ornn''' uses his craftsmanship in forgery to upgrade {{tt|most|See notes}} [[Legendary item]]s that he and his teammates own into {{sbc|Masterwork}} items, increasing the [[Gold efficiency (League of Legends)|gold value]] of all {{tt|upgradeable stats|See notes}} on the item by exactly {{g|1000}}, shared equally among them. When '''Ornn''' reaches [[Experience (champion)|level]] 13, the first eligible [[Legendary item]] in his inventory is upgraded automatically. For each level after 13 and before 18 (levels 14–17, total of 4, once per ally per game), '''Ornn''' can upgrade the first eligible [[Legendary item]] in an allied champion's inventory into its {{sbc|Masterwork}} variant. He can do so by selecting the ally while within 600 range, and forges the item's upgrade by performing ''Living Forge's'' {{tip|channel}}.

Additionally, '''Ornn''' increases his {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' armor}}}}, {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' magic resistance}}}} and {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' health}}}} by 10% from all sources, further increased by 4% each time he upgrades a ''Legendary'' item into a {{sbc|Masterwork}} item, for a total increase of 30% to each stat after the maximum of 5 upgrades.
params.description3: {{sbc|Innate - Temper:}} '''Ornn''' applies {{tip|Brittle}} to enemies hit by ''{{ai|Bellows Breath|Ornn}}'' and ''{{ai|Call of the Forge God|Ornn}}''. His {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} against enemies afflicted with ''Brittle'' are empowered to {{tip|airborne|knock them back}} a short distance over {{tt|{{fd|0.4}} seconds|Estimated}}. '''Ornn's''' and allies' {{tip|immobilize|immobilizing}} effects or {{tip|silence|silences}} against ''Brittle'' enemies will consume the debuff to deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} equal to {{as|{{pp|key=%|type='''Ornn's''' level|9 + (17-9)/17*(x-1) for 20}} of the target's '''maximum''' health}}, capped at {{pp|type=[[File:Bellows Breath.png|20px|border]] ''Bellows Breath's'' rank|200 to 500 for 6|0 to 5|formula=200 + 60 per rank of ''Bellows Breath''}} against {{tip|monsters}}, and cause the crowd control to last 30% longer (if applicable).
params.description4: ''The {{sbc|Masterwork}} upgrade scans each item slot in the champion's inventory (from slots 1-6) for an eligible Legendary item, upgrading the first eligible item that is found.''
params.notes: * '''Ornn's''' ''Forge Menu'' is a special menu in the HUD which has 5 slots. The player can quickly forge one of the recommended items by {{LMB}} clicking on its portrait or via the Champion Specific Interaction [[hotkey]]s (default: {{sbc|Shift}}+{{sbc|F1–F5}}). * The item that '''Ornn''' upgrades for the ally is decided at the start of the forge channel. ** If the ally moves the item into a different slot during the channel, it will still be the item that gets upgraded. * {{sbc|Masterwork}} items inherit all properties of their pre-upgrade version, including the cooldowns of their [[Named item effect|effects]]. Internally, they are handled through an item modifier. An upgraded item gains the ('''{{as|Masterwork|buzzword3}}''') descriptor next to its name in tooltips as well as a special Masterwork frame overlay on the item's icon itself, both indicating the application of ''Living Forge's'' modifier. * Statistics' gold value and eligible stats to be increased for {{sbc|Masterwork}} items: ** {{g|31.25}} per 1 point of {{as|ability haste}}. ** {{g|20}} per 1 point of {{as|ability power}}. ** {{g|35}} per 1 point of {{as|attack damage}}. ** {{g|30}} per 1% of {{as|attack speed}}. ** {{g|20}} per 1 point of {{as|armor}}. ** {{g|18}} per 1 point of {{as|magic resistance}}. ** 1 point of {{as|health}} has a variable {{g|gold value}}, based on the number of upgradeable stats that exist on the item: **# If health is the item's only upgradeable stat, it receives +375 health and health is valued at {{g|2.{{recurring|6}}}} per point. **# If the item has health and only one other upgradeable stat, it receives +185 health and health is valued at {{g|2.{{recurring|702}}}} per point. **# If the item has health and two other upgradeable stats, it receives +125 health and health is valued at {{g|2.{{recurring|6}}}} per point. **# If the item has health and three other upgradeable stats, it receives +90 health and health is valued at {{g|2.{{recurring|7}}}} per point. ** While not currently possible, if an item has no upgradeable stats, {{g|1000}} worth of health (valued at {{g|2.{{recurring|6}}}} per point) is added to the item.[https://www.reddit.com/r/leagueoflegends/comments/1d2g5g8/why_does_edge_of_finality_only_give_525_gold/l64is3z/?context=3 GalaxySmash on if an item has no upgradeable stats] * The {{sbc|Masterwork}} stat increases are rounded down (any decimal values are lost). * ''Living Forge's'' bonus {{as|armor}} and {{as|magic resist}} increase {{tip|stacks additively}} with {{iis|Jak'Sho, The Protean}} {{nie|Voidborn Resilience}} and {{tip|stacks multiplicatively|multiplicatively}} with {{bi|Mountainous Vigor}}. * Health and mana items built on the field will retain '''Ornn's''' previous {{as|health}} and {{as|mana}} percentage. Returning to base still brings health and mana back to full. * '''Ornn's''' basic attacks against {{tip|Brittle}} enemies will end the duration of the debuff {{tip|on-hit}} prematurely even if the {{tip|airborne|knock back}} was not applied. This does not trigger the consumed effect that deals the bonus damage, unless the target was an epic {{tip|monster}}. * {{tip|Brittle|Brittle's}} {{tip|Tenacity}} reduction will benefit all applicable types of {{tip|crowd control}}, not just {{tip|immobilize|immobilizes}} and {{tip|silence|silences}}. The following do not consume ''Brittle'' but benefit from the reduction: {{tip|blind|blinds}}, {{tip|cripple|cripples}}, {{tip|disarm|disarms}}, {{tip|ground|grounds}}, and {{tip|slow|slows}}. * {{tip|Spell shield}} will block both the knock back and the bonus damage from '''Ornn's''' empowered {{tip|brittle}} attack. * The {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} inflicted by ''Brittle'' is credited to '''Ornn''', and benefits from his {{sti|{{as|magic penetration}}}}. * The {{sbc|Masterwork}} item upgrade on an ally will fail if the ally was channeling the [[File:Rift Herald Rodeo buff.png|20px|link=Rift Herald]] ''[[Rift_Herald#Abilities_2|Rift Herald Rodeo]]'' at the time of the forge's completion.{{bug}} * The following table refers for interactions while '''Ornn''' is {{tip|channel|channeling}}: ** All of '''Ornn's''' actions are disabled during the first {{fd|0.5}} seconds of the channel. {{ct|channel|attack=interrupts|cast=interrupts|move=interrupts|items=interrupts,,, false|consume=interrupts|spells=interrupts|interrupts=death, silence|damage=true}}
params.tips:
* Although {{tip|airborne}} effects won't be extended by {{tip|Brittle}}, if the spell simultaneously {{tip|stun|stuns}} the target, this stun will be extended and persist past the airborne duration, for an overall increased crowd control duration.
** ''{{cai|Searing Charge|Ornn}}'' and ''{{ai|Call of the Forge God|Ornn}}'' each apply both airborne and stun simultaneously for the same duration for this reason.

description.plain: Innate - Living Forge: Ornn can purchase items from the shop even while outside of its range and from anywhere on the battlefield, by forging them. He is able to forge any non-consumable item, and is also presented a Forge Menu to quickly forge his recommended items. Once Ornn attempts to purchase an item, he starts forging it, causing him to channel for 4 seconds. Upon completion of the channel, he builds the item and pays its gold gold cost. The channel is interrupted if Ornn takes damage from enemy champions or turrets. Living Forge is disabled for 4 seconds after starting the channel.

description2.plain: Innate - Master Craftsman: Ornn uses his craftsmanship in forgery to upgrade most Legendary items that he and his teammates own into Masterwork items, increasing the gold value of all upgradeable stats on the item by exactly 1000 gold, shared equally among them. When Ornn reaches level 13, the first eligible Legendary item in his inventory is upgraded automatically. For each level after 13 and before 18 (levels 14–17, total of 4, once per ally per game), Ornn can upgrade the first eligible Legendary item in an allied champion's inventory into its Masterwork variant. He can do so by selecting the ally while within 600 range, and forges the item's upgrade by performing Living Forge's channel. Additionally, Ornn increases his bonus armor, bonus magic resistance and bonus health by 10% from all sources, further increased by 4% each time he upgrades a Legendary item into a Masterwork item, for a total increase of 30% to each stat after the maximum of 5 upgrades.

description3.plain: Innate - Temper: Ornn applies Brittle to enemies hit by Bellows Breath and Call of the Forge God. His basic attacks on-hit against enemies afflicted with Brittle are empowered to knock them back a short distance over 0.4 seconds. Ornn's and allies' immobilizing effects or silences against Brittle enemies will consume the debuff to deal bonus magic damage equal to 9% – 17.94% (based on Ornn's level) of the target's maximum health, capped at 200 – 500 (based on Bellows Breath's rank) against monsters, and cause the crowd control to last 30% longer (if applicable).

description4.plain: The Masterwork upgrade scans each item slot in the champion's inventory (from slots 1-6) for an eligible Legendary item, upgrading the first eligible item that is found.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Ornn}} sends a fissure in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} and {{tip|slow|slows}} enemies hit for a short time.
params.blurb2: The fissure stops upon hitting an enemy {{tip|champion}} or max range, erupting a pillar of [[terrain]] that {{tip|airborne|knocks aside}} enemies and lingers for a few seconds.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ornn''' sends a fissure in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|slow|slows}} them by 40% for 2 seconds.
params.description2: The fissure stops at maximum range or 200 units behind the first enemy champion struck. After a {{fd|1.125}}-second delay, a magma pillar then erupts at the location to {{tip|airborne|knock aside}} enemies, though not through terrain, and linger as impassible terrain for 4 seconds.
params.description3: ''The pillar will not expire during {{ais|Searing Charge|Ornn}} dash.''
params.notes:
* The fissure will move an 200 units beyond the first champion it hits, not exceeding the maximum range of the ability. ''It can still damage additional targets.''
* If launched in a wall, pillar will try to appear on the other side of the wall, if it cannot the pillar will be destroyed.
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will not prevent the {{tip|airborne|knock aside}} from the magma pillar forming.
{{Effect at cast time start}}

params.target range: {{dv|{{tt|500|Flame standard length}}|{{tt|560|Final gout of flame length}}}}
params.notes:
* '''Ornn's''' lunge distance is based on the distance he would travel in the target direction by standard movement over a time period of {{fd|0.75}} seconds with {{as|35% of his '''total''' movement speed}}.
** His {{as|movement speed}} during the lunge does not actually change in this case and is only used as a scaling.
*** The scaling is based on the {{as|'''total''' movement speed}} '''Ornn''' had at the time of casting ''Bellows Breath''.
**** If his {{as|'''total''' movement speed}} was less than or equal to an estimated value of 190, then '''Ornn''' will not lunge at all.
* While lunging, special VFX will be played when '''Ornn''' is first affected by {{tip|crowd control}}, even if that crowd control is not resisted by {{tip|displacement immunity}}.
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will negate the final instance of damage and prevents {{tip|Brittle}} from being applied.
* '''Ornn''' can see the on-target VFX on targets that are being struck even while they are in the [[Sight|fog of war]].
* ''Bellows Breath's'' {{tip|lunge}} can pass over thin, [[Terrain#Player-Generated|player-generated terrain]] (i.e {{cai|R|Jarvan IV}}) but will otherwise not be able to.{{bug|2}}

params.blurb:
{{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Ornn}} summons a lava elemental that stampedes toward him, dealing {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|slow|slowing}} enemies hit for a short time.

''Call of the Forge God'' can be recast while the elemental is active.
params.blurb2: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Ornn''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} in the target direction. If he hits the elemental, he sends it stampeding in the new direction, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit, {{tip|airborne|knocking them up}} and {{tip|stun|stunning}} them for a brief time.
params.blurb3: Each pass applies {{tip|Brittle}} to enemies hit for a short time.
params.blurb4: {{sbc|{{tip|Brittle|nolink=true}}:}} The target loses {{sti|tenacity}}, increasing the duration of incoming {{tip|crowd control}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ornn''' sounds his horn, summoning a lava elemental at maximum range from the target direction that stampedes towards his casting position at increasing speed. The elemental deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies it passes through and {{tip|slow|slows}} them for 2 seconds.
params.description2: ''Call of the Forge God'' can be recast after {{tt|{{fd|1.25}}|Includes the cast time}} seconds while the elemental is active.
params.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Ornn''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} in the target direction, though not through terrain. If he collides with the elemental, he sends it stampeding in the same direction. The elemental deals the same damage to enemies it passes through and {{tip|airborne|knocks them up}} and {{tip|stun|stuns}} them for 1 second, reduced to {{fd|0.5}} seconds after the first enemy {{tip|champion}} hit.
params.description4: Each pass applies {{tip|Brittle}} to targets for 3 seconds and can affect enemies only once. The elemental briefly grants {{tip|sight}} around its trajectory as it travels.
params.effect radius: {{dv|{{tt|3000|Elemental incoming range towards Ornn (first pass)}}|{{tt|2550|Elemental outgoing range after recast collision (second pass)}}}}
params.speed: {{dv|{{tt|1600|Recast dash speed}}|{{tt|450|Elemental base speed}}|{{tt|1250|Elemental maximum speed, reached in approximately 0.6 seconds (has an inconsistent acceleration)}}}}
params.notes:
* Both casts count as ability activations for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.
** Despite this, the effects of both casts count as the same {{tip|cast instance}}.
* ''Call of the Forge God'' cannot be recast while {{tip|ground|grounded}} or {{tip|root|rooted}}.
* {{tip|Brittle}} enemies without {{tip|Tenacity}} of their own will be {{tip|stun|stunned}} for a total of {{fd|1.3}} seconds.
* {{tip|Spell shield|Spell shields}} may only block one pass.
* '''Ornn''' becomes locked out of all actions during the recast's dash and for {{fd|0.5}} seconds afterwards.
{{Effect at cast time start}}
* {{tip|Displacement immunity}} will also resist the application of the {{tip|stun}}.
